description: Measures GPU memory bandwidth in three directions: Host-to-Device (H2D), Device-to-Host (D2H), and Device-to-Device (D2D) using hipMemcpy with pinned host memory. Emits per-iteration GPU event time and host time records (total = sum of transfer times); bandwidth in GB/s is derived downstream.

scaling_param.name: buffer_size_mb
scaling_param.description: Transfer buffer size in MiB; controls the total data volume per transfer

non_scaling_params.name: use_pinned_memory
non_scaling_params.description: Whether to use pinned (page-locked) host memory for transfers
